errors.evidence: The x-axis in the figure has year labels at every year from 2001 to 2021, not every two years.

errors.text_span: започва от стойност около 100 през 2001 година
errors.evidence: The SOFIX line starts around 150 in 2001, as indicated in the reference and visible in the chart, not about 100.
The figure/legend uses the label BG40 on the right axis, but the machine description also misstates its start year and peak values; this span is tied to the same incorrectly described series.

errors.text_span: започва от стойност около 100 през 2004 година, достига връх от около 1400 през 2007 година и след това рязко спада до под 100 към 2009 година. След 2010 година стойностите ѝ остават ниски, около или под 100, до края на периода.
errors.evidence: BG40 starts around 2005 near 200, peaks around 1300 in 2007, falls to about 200 in 2009, and ends around 300 by 2021; it does not start in 2004 at 100 or remain at/below 100 after 2010.

errors.text_span: започва от около 100 през 2013 година и показва бавно покачване до около 200 към 2021 година
errors.evidence: BGBX40 starts around 100 in 2014 and ends around 250–300 in 2021, not around 200; the start year is also off by about one year.
The description does not mention that the x-axis has yearly tick labels for every year from 2001 to 2021, as shown in the figure and noted in the reference.
